4.2: Customer Data (Input and Output) stays the customer's and is not used to train the LTX Model; 2.2(i): Output may not train competing models. AUP (2026-03-30): commercially used Output must not replicate a real likeness, brand or location unless cleared.

Self-serve is prepaid credits; 'Pay As You Go is available only to Enterprise Customers via Order Form' (1.30). NOT read: the LTX-2 API Credit Terms and any order form. No age clause found. Sign-up and payment from Uzbekistan not verified.
